name: Swiss International
tagline: The grid is the story: flush-left grotesk, red, black and white on visible modules.
description: International Typographic Style in motion: a strict modular grid shown as hairlines, huge flush-left ragged-right grotesk, objective geometry and numbers, red/black/white blocks that slide along grid lines and snap module by module, and bar wipes that fill the grid row by row or column by column.

signature: bar wipe on the grid: bars fill row by row (or column by column) with a 1–2 frame stagger, the layout changes underneath, the bars retract
modular slide: blocks move along grid lines and snap module by module to the next layout
type enters from a baseline mask, flush left on a column edge

camera: No camera. The frame is the page: everything moves in its plane along the grid; at most a straight cut-in to a module that then becomes the page.

texture.notes: Flat ink on off-white paper. The only 'texture' is the visible grid: 1 px hairlines for column and row edges, column indices in the margin.

lighting: None. Flat, objective colour; no shadows, gradients or glows.
sound: Precise and dry: a clean tick per module step, a short filtered swipe per bar, a soft low thud when a block lands; minimal, metronomic music.

beats.label: Bars fill row by row, 12 is set underneath
Blocks slide module by module into Form
Column bars set the poster again

motionSummary: Moves like a page re-setting itself: bars sweep the grid row by row, the layout changes underneath, blocks slide module by module into the next poster.

composition: a visible 12 × 6 modular grid; every element starts and ends on a column edge
asymmetric: one large colour block, one huge word or number, one small information column, many empty modules
flush left, ragged right; nothing centred
visual.shapeLanguage: rectangles, squares, circles and rules sized in whole modules; 1 px hairlines; no radii except true circles
visual.contrast: high and flat: ink and signal red on off-white paper, large confident blocks, no shadows or gradients

grammar.pacing: metronomic: a move (6–20 f), then a hold (20–30 f), then the next move; one layout per bar of music
grammar.rhythm: mechanical and quantised: positions and sizes step in whole modules; bars stagger 1–2 f per row or column
grammar.easing: decisive in-out for moves ([0.8,0,0.2,1]), fast ease-out entries, ease-in exits; no bounce, no overshoot
grammar.acceleration: hard acceleration and a clean stop on the module; no drift, no settle
movement: bar wipe filling the grid row by row or column by column
blocks sliding along grid lines and snapping module by module
a circle squaring into a band module by module
type rising from a baseline mask, flush left on a column edge
grammar.density: low and orderly: 1–2 blocks move at once; the grid stays still
grammar.holds: every layout holds as a finished poster for 0.7–1 s before it changes

transitionPresets.name: Bar wipe (rows)
transitionPresets.build: ink bars extend across each row left → right, 1–2 f apart, 6 f each; when every row is covered the layout is swapped underneath; the bars retract toward the right in the same order; gutters stay visible as paper lines
transitionPresets.sound: a short filtered swipe per bar

transitionPresets.name: Bar wipe (columns)
transitionPresets.build: red (or ink) bars drop down each column, 1 f apart, the next layout is set under them, the bars retract downward; used to return or to change chapter
transitionPresets.sound: a run of ticks, one per column

transitionPresets.name: Modular slide
transitionPresets.bridge: a block shared by both layouts
transitionPresets.build: the block resizes and travels along grid lines into its place in the next layout, rounded to whole modules every frame so it steps column by column; a circle squares into a band the same way
transitionPresets.sound: a clean tick per module step, a low thud on landing

transitionPresets.name: Module push
transitionPresets.build: the whole layout pushes sideways one module-width at a time (stepped), the next page following on the same grid

transitionPresets.name: Number match
transitionPresets.bridge: a number, rule or circle in both layouts
transitionPresets.build: cut where the shared element sits on the same column edge: a number becomes a module count, a rule becomes a bar, a circle becomes the next layout's dot

transitionPresets.name: Module zoom
transitionPresets.build: a straight scale into one module until its edges leave the frame; its contents are the next page, set on the same grid (scale only, no blur)

archetypes.name: Poster
archetypes.purpose: state the subject as a typographic poster
archetypes.composition: a red block of whole modules, a huge flush-left word on the bottom rows, a small information column on a column edge
archetypes.elements: display word, info column (place, dates), column indices, red block
archetypes.motion: type rises from its baseline mask; the info column sets line by line

archetypes.name: Number plate
archetypes.composition: a black half-page with one geometric form (red circle), a huge number flush left in the other half, a red rule
archetypes.motion: the number rises from its baseline; the rule extends on the grid

archetypes.name: Module layout
archetypes.purpose: explain: several facts in a strict structure
archetypes.composition: blocks re-arranged into a new layout (a red band, a 4 × 2 black module), body text in ragged-right columns
archetypes.elements: band with a word, small black module with a number, 2–3 text columns
archetypes.motion: blocks step into place module by module; text columns set one after the other

archetypes.name: Data grid
archetypes.composition: bars or squares sized in whole modules, one in red, labels flush left beneath
archetypes.motion: bars grow module by module in sequence; the red one last

archetypes.name: Colophon
archetypes.composition: the name flush left on a column edge, one rule, a small block of details; mostly empty modules
archetypes.motion: rule extends, name rises, details set; hold

beats.motion: type rises flush left, the red block sits on the grid
bars wipe, the number plate is set underneath
blocks slide module by module into new layouts
the red bar steps up last and holds
a column wipe sets the colophon; hold

sequence.cutRhythm: changes on the bar: a move, a hold, a move; wipes and slides replace cuts; straight cuts only as match cuts on a shared column edge

scenes.action: 'Raster' rises flush left on the bottom rows, a red 4-module block top right, 'Ausstellung / Halle 8 / 14.3.—2.5.' sets in the info column
ink bars fill the rows; under them a black half-page with a red circle and a huge '12' ('Spalten'); the bars retract
the circle squares into a red band carrying 'Form', the black half shrinks to a 4 × 2 module with '08', body text sets in three columns
the page pushes one module left; six bars step up module by module, the red one last: '128 × 137'
red column bars drop and retract; 'Raster und Form' flush left, a rule, 'Halle 8 · Di—So 10—18'; hold

elements.text: flush left on a column edge, rising from a baseline mask; size and weight jumps for hierarchy; exits by an ease-in drop behind the same mask or under a bar
elements.logo: a wordmark set in the display grotesk flush left, or a module-sized mark; it is set like type, never animated as an object
elements.icons: pure geometry in whole modules (circle, square, bar, arrow); they step into place
elements.images: objective photography cropped to modules, black-and-white or a single red duotone; revealed by a bar wipe
elements.ui: redrawn as grid modules and rules; no rounded cards or shadows
elements.shapes: rectangles, circles, rules and bars in whole modules; they slide and resize along grid lines
elements.background: flat off-white paper with the grid shown as hairlines and column indices; never changes colour except under a full bar wipe

audio.sync: every move starts on a beat and lasts a whole number of beats subdivisions; module steps on 16ths as ticks; holds of one bar
audio.sfx: dry ticks per module, short filtered swipes per bar, a low thud on a block landing; minimal electronic music or silence
